queries.query: SELECT id, full_name, status, salary, active, birth_date, created_at FROM person ORDER BY id
SELECT id, full_name, status, salary, active, birth_date, created_at FROM person WHERE id = ?1
SELECT id, full_name, status, salary, active, birth_date, created_at FROM person WHERE ?1 IS NULL OR UPPER(status) = ?1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM person WHERE birth_date < ?1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM person ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE active = TRUE
UPDATE person SET active = FALSE, status = 'inactive' WHERE id = ?1
UPDATE person SET full_name = ?2 WHERE id = ?1
INSERT INTO person (id, full_name, status, salary, active) VALUES (?1, ?2, 'active', 0, TRUE)
